# Device overlay

What Danbyte adds to one upstream NetBox device type, in `danbyte/overlays/<Vendor>/<model>.yaml`. It names its upstream file and adds or patches only what Danbyte needs: Danbyte keys (`model3d`, `rack_mount`, `meta`), NetBox top-level keys that need correcting, and component lists patched by name with `add:` / `remove:` entries that each say `why`. The merge (`danbyte-lib preview`) is what Danbyte imports; upstream fixes flow in untouched, and `sync-check` reports patched names that upstream no longer has.

Schema: [`danbyte/schema/overlay.schema.json`](../../schema/overlay.schema.json) (danbyte-library/v1).

Files: `danbyte/overlays/<Vendor>/<model>.yaml`. Start each with the editor line, so VS Code (YAML extension) completes and checks keys as you type:

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=<relative path to>/danbyte/schema/overlay.schema.json
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | [format](common.md#format) |  | The library format this file is written for. Optional; the tools write it, and a later format will change the value. |
| `upstream` | string (pattern) | yes | The NetBox YAML this overlay adds to, relative to the repository root: an upstream file under `device-types/`, or a Danbyte-only base under `danbyte/types-new/device-types/` for hardware upstream doesn't have yet. Never edited by the overlay. |
| `meta` | [meta](meta.md) |  | Catalog facts (see meta). |
| `model3d` | [model3d](common.md#model3d) |  | The 3D model of a device or module type (export spec §1-§8). Danbyte assembles a device from its chassis file plus one file per installed module, placed at the chassis' `bay:` empties, and lights `led:` meshes from live status. |
| `rack_mount` | [rackMount](common.md#rackmount) |  | How the device sits on a rack's rails (export spec §3, §8 "Rack mounting"). Danbyte puts the ear plane on the rack's front rail and the faceplate at the chosen position's offset. |
| `part_number` | string |  | NetBox key, overriding upstream: The vendor part number, when upstream's is wrong. |
| `u_height` | number (0–…) |  | NetBox key, overriding upstream: Height in rack units. |
| `is_full_depth` | boolean |  | NetBox key, overriding upstream: Whether it occupies the rack's full depth. |
| `airflow` | string |  | NetBox key, overriding upstream: NetBox airflow slug (front-to-rear, rear-to-front, …). |
| `weight` | number (0–…) |  | NetBox key, overriding upstream: Weight, in weight_unit. |
| `weight_unit` | one of `kg`, `g`, `lb`, `oz` |  | NetBox key, overriding upstream: Unit of weight. |
| `front_image` | boolean |  | NetBox key, overriding upstream: Whether a front elevation image exists. |
| `rear_image` | boolean |  | NetBox key, overriding upstream: Whether a rear elevation image exists. |
| `subdevice_role` | one of `parent`, `child` |  | NetBox key, overriding upstream: NetBox subdevice role. |
| `is_powered` | boolean |  | NetBox key, overriding upstream: Whether the type draws power. |
| `description` | string |  | NetBox key, overriding upstream: Short description. |
| `comments` | string |  | NetBox key, overriding upstream: Free text (Markdown). |
| `console-ports` | [consolePortSection](common.md#consoleportsection) |  | `console-ports:` patched by name. Each key is the name of a console port upstream has, mapped to the fields to change; `add:` lists new ones (each with `why`), `remove:` drops upstream ones (each with `why`). The upstream list itself is never rewritten. |
| `console-server-ports` | [consoleServerPortSection](common.md#consoleserverportsection) |  | `console-server-ports:` patched by name. Each key is the name of a console server port upstream has, mapped to the fields to change; `add:` lists new ones (each with `why`), `remove:` drops upstream ones (each with `why`). The upstream list itself is never rewritten. |
| `power-ports` | [powerPortSection](common.md#powerportsection) |  | `power-ports:` patched by name. Each key is the name of a power port (inlet) upstream has, mapped to the fields to change; `add:` lists new ones (each with `why`), `remove:` drops upstream ones (each with `why`). The upstream list itself is never rewritten. |
| `power-outlets` | [powerOutletSection](common.md#poweroutletsection) |  | `power-outlets:` patched by name. Each key is the name of a power outlet upstream has, mapped to the fields to change; `add:` lists new ones (each with `why`), `remove:` drops upstream ones (each with `why`). The upstream list itself is never rewritten. |
| `interfaces` | [interfaceSection](common.md#interfacesection) |  | `interfaces:` patched by name. Each key is the name of an interface upstream has, mapped to the fields to change; `add:` lists new ones (each with `why`), `remove:` drops upstream ones (each with `why`). The upstream list itself is never rewritten. |
| `front-ports` | [frontPortSection](common.md#frontportsection) |  | `front-ports:` patched by name. Each key is the name of a front port upstream has, mapped to the fields to change; `add:` lists new ones (each with `why`), `remove:` drops upstream ones (each with `why`). The upstream list itself is never rewritten. |
| `rear-ports` | [rearPortSection](common.md#rearportsection) |  | `rear-ports:` patched by name. Each key is the name of a rear port upstream has, mapped to the fields to change; `add:` lists new ones (each with `why`), `remove:` drops upstream ones (each with `why`). The upstream list itself is never rewritten. |
| `module-bays` | [moduleBaySection](common.md#modulebaysection) |  | `module-bays:` patched by name. Each key is the name of a module bay upstream has, mapped to the fields to change; `add:` lists new ones (each with `why`), `remove:` drops upstream ones (each with `why`). The upstream list itself is never rewritten. |
| `device-bays` | [deviceBaySection](common.md#devicebaysection) |  | `device-bays:` patched by name. Each key is the name of a device bay upstream has, mapped to the fields to change; `add:` lists new ones (each with `why`), `remove:` drops upstream ones (each with `why`). The upstream list itself is never rewritten. |
| `inventory-items` | [inventoryItemSection](common.md#inventoryitemsection) |  | `inventory-items:` patched by name. Each key is the name of an inventory item upstream has, mapped to the fields to change; `add:` lists new ones (each with `why`), `remove:` drops upstream ones (each with `why`). The upstream list itself is never rewritten. |

Example:

```yaml
upstream: device-types/Cisco/C9300-24P.yaml
meta: {category: switch, family: Catalyst 9300}
interfaces:
  StackPort1/1: {type: cisco-stackwise-480}

power-ports:
  add:
    - {name: StackPower1/A, type: cisco-stackpower, why: 'StackPower receptacle, rear panel'}

module-bays:
  PS-A:
    modules: [PWR-C1-350WAC-P, PWR-C1-715WAC-P]

model3d: {file: assets/Cisco/C9300-24P.glb}
```
